title: Cipla Global Supply Chain Head Venkata Sai Mungara Moves to Cipla USA Role

contentHtml:
Mumbai: Cipla Limited has announced that Venkata Sai Mungara, currently Global Head Supply Chain, will transition to the role of Chief of Manufacturing and Supply Chain Operations of Cipla USA Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the company, with effect from October 1, 2026. Following the transition, Mungara will cease to be a Senior Management Personnel of Cipla Limited.

Venkata Sai Mungara will move from his existing position as Global Head Supply Chain to Chief of Manufacturing and Supply Chain Operations of Cipla USA Inc. The transition to the wholly owned subsidiary will take effect from October 1, 2026. Consequently, he will cease to hold the position of Senior Management Personnel of Cipla Limited from the same date.

The company has specified that the change is pursuant to Mungara’s transition to the new role at Cipla USA Inc. The terms of appointment or reappointment are stated as not applicable. The brief profile section is also marked as not applicable, as is the disclosure concerning relationships between directors in the case of appointment of a director.
